title: The web landing offers Tracy Desktop beside the zip; the app is sent to the waiting template
steps: S1: run apps/tracy-web/test/desktop-surface.test.mjs — the TracyCowork/<version> token is the only thing that reads as the app.
S2: run apps/tracy-web/test/quickstart-download.test.mjs — the door with a fake GitHub: any signed-in session, browser or app, streams the zip exactly as before #1171; no session is 401.

S3: run apps/tracy-web/test/template-intent.test.mjs — /new?template=<id> on the web (Build + Download, then the Tracy Desktop offer naming the account, the template left waiting with its platform) and in the app (Build + Download, no offer, the waiting row consumed); the root follows a waiting template in the app only.
S4: migration 091-desktop-intent-platform.sql is present; the download door reads no user agent.
expect: S2: exit 0, 0 failures (the Postgres case may be skipped without TEST_DATABASE_URL); the no-session-401 and signed-in-stream cases pass.
S3: exit 0, 0 failures, 0 skipped; the web-landing (zip then offer), no-zip, app-landing, root-in-app and root-on-web cases pass.
S4: apps/tracy-web/src/db/migrations/091-desktop-intent-platform.sql present; apps/tracy-web/src/quickstarts/download.js does not import lib/desktop-surface.js.
fence: The web and the app have the same features (11/10/2026): the download door serves every signed-in session and reads no user agent. The user-agent token never opens a sign-in, a seat, a profile or a model; it only decides the Tracy Desktop offer on the web landing and the handoff (web writes the waiting template, the app consumes it and its root follows it).
